# Generate AI Development Prompt

Learn the local project /Users/yuxuanli/Desktop/Project/Knowledge-Tree, espacially the user profile page, database, auth design and architecture. Generate a prompt file to develop a subscribe feature for the user profile page under .github/prompts/feature_user_prompt.md.

Requirement:

- Make the subscribe feature entrance visible on the user profile page, preferably at the left side of "share" button on the user profile page.
- On your own profile page, a total ”Followers“ and "Following" count should be displayed. By clicking on the ”Followers“ or "Following" count, the corresponding user list shall be seen. Allow users to manage their subscriptions or view the followers.
- When visiting other users' profile pages, the subscribe button should be displayed. If the current user is already subscribed to that user, the button should indicate "Unsubscribe"; otherwise, it should show "Subscribe". Total "Followers" count should also be displayed, but not the "Following" count.
- Implement backend logic to handle subscribe and unsubscribe actions, ensuring that the follower and following counts are updated correctly and reflected in the user interface. The backend logic and database design should follow the current system design and architecture.
